 Order

This writ petition is filed for following reliefs:
a) To issue writ of Mandamus against respondents no.3 and 4 not to release award amount in respect of land bearing Sy.no.11 in favour of respondents no.1 and 2/ third parties until final adjudication of respective right and share of petitioner before Hon'ble Civil Judge Court, Bengaluru in O.S.no.1191/2018 and under Section 31 and 32 of Land Acquisition Act etc.

2. Sri Sridhar B.R., learned counsel appearing for Sri M Shiva Prakash, learned counsel for petitioner submitted NC: 2023:KHC:40511 that said prayer was sought on ground that there was rival claim in respect of compensation on account of acquisition of portion of land in Sy.no.11,
Smt Bhagyalakshmi vs Sri Ramachandrappa on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41567380/
2 measuring 3 acres 20 Guntas each situated at Thalaghattapura village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk, was acquired by BMRCL - respondent no.3.

It was submitted that since respondents have passed award and were about to pay compensation, petitioner sought to restrain them from paying compensation to respondents no.1 and 2.
3.

Sri P.V. Chandrashekar, learned counsel for respondents no.4 referring to statement of objections would submit that in view of dispute between petitioner, respondents no.1 and 2 and others,
respondent no.4 had referred matter for adjudication under Sections 30 and 31 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
In view of reference relief sought for by petitioner in present writ petition would not survive for consideration and therefore sought for dismissal of writ petition.

4. In view of above and since dispute insofar as entitlement of compensation is to be adjudicated before Reference Court, and matter has already been referred, writ petition is disposed of reserving liberty to petitioner and NC: 2023:KHC:40511 respondents to work out their remedies before Reference Court.

Sd/-
